title: Let praise dye the whole life true
summary: Let truth grow visible in the way the body moves through the day. Keep this close: Let this stay with you: let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: Praise and saintly company dye conduct with truth.
source.lifeApplication: Before polishing the outside, return to praise and one truthful act.
